measurement.webview: The packaged src/webview/main.ts bundle built for Chromium
measurement.instrumentation: Explicit benchmark-only hook; production build disables it
measurement.latencyDefinition: Elapsed browser time from immediately before a real Playwright keyboard/pointer action until the Rich Editor DOM reflects the edit
measurement.stressInteractionPhaseDefinition: Browser performance.now() milestones around real locator wait/click and keyboard actions; DOM reflection is timestamped by a MutationObserver on the target table cell

tableStructure.operation: Insert row using the real Rich Editor row-insert control
